messages:
Sanjay R: Postmortem up for the ETL lag + missing spans incident from last night. Root cause looks like late shard rotation + retry suppression in the aggregator. Need owners for follow-ups and concrete timelines.
Devon P: thanks — can you paste the action list here? I can take aggregator fixes if that works.
Sanjay R: Action summary: 1) fix aggregator retry suppression (owner: Devon) 2) backfill missing spans (owner: Maria) 3) alert tuning + dashboard (owner: Elaine) 4) e2e test + CI check for shard rotation (owner: Taylor) 5) retention/dedupe postprocessing audit (owner: TBD). Proposing 2-week SLA baseline; some items shorter.
Maria K: I can own the backfill. ETA: 4 days for staging run + validation, 2–3 days for prod run + monitoring. Will need infra help for extra ETL workers.
Devon P: Plan for aggregator change: revert the `suppress-retries` behavior and introduce guarded retries w/ exponential backoff + jitter. Steps:
- PR by EOD Fri
- Canary for 24h
- Full rollout next Tue
I will add unit tests and a feature flag for quick rollback.
incident-bot: Reminder: postmortem created by Sanjay R — follow-ups due 2024-11-21. :bell:
Elaine S: For alerts, let's move from static rate thresholds to an anomaly-detector + rolling baseline. Draft alert SQL:
```
SELECT count(*) AS dropped FROM spans WHERE status = 'dropped' AND ts > now() - interval '5 minutes';
-- compare dropped / moving_avg(dropped, '1 hour') > 3
```
I'll add a dashboard card with burn rate, pct-late, and per-tenant diffs. ETA 7 days.
Taylor L: I'll add an integration test that simulates connector rebalancing/shard rotation and asserts no span loss + KV cache integrity. Will also add a nightly CI job. Estimate 5 days; may need a small harness.
Sanjay R: Ownership acked. Devon / Maria / Elaine / Taylor — please add tasks to the postmortem doc and tag owners. Also propose a weekly health-check: run `SELECT count(*) FROM aggregator WHERE lag > 30s` and open a ticket if > X. This will surface recurring patterns (we saw two similar incidents last 6 months).
Maria K: I added a scheduled backfill runbook draft in the doc and listed infra dependencies + rollback steps.
Devon P: FYI I pulled history: two prior events with the same symptom (missing spans + sudden aggregation drop) around 2024-08 and 2024-09. I'll assemble a short timeline for the follow-up sync.
Elaine S: Suggest QA regression check: compare pre/post aggregation histograms by tenant and fail if >0.5% delta. Will include visual diff in dashboard.
Taylor L: If infra can provide ephemeral workers for the prod backfill window I can parallelize shards and cut runtime significantly — cc @infra-team.
Sanjay R: Scheduling a sync: Mon 2024-10-31 10:00 to confirm PR status and backfill window. If you can't make it, drop notes in the doc.
incident-bot: Meeting created: ETL-followup-sync 2024-10-31 10:00 by Sanjay R — https://meet.redwood.ai/etl-followup
Devon P: ack — will post PR link in this thread when ready.
Maria K: ack — will post staging backfill logs here after the run.
Elaine S: ack — will share dashboard mockups before the sync.
Taylor L: ack — starting the integration test branch today and will push updates.
Sanjay R: Closing loop: update the postmortem doc with owners & deadlines; we'll re-check in next ops sync. If blockers appear ping me directly. Thanks all :clap:
